title: OmniKali BIST production evidence input
description: Optional evidence file consumed by scripts/bist.mjs via OMNIKALI_BIST_EVIDENCE or evidence/bist-production.json. A check is ignored unless acceptanceId is a non-empty string and status is in the BIST vocabulary.

acceptanceId.description: Authorized live-acceptance identifier. Historical IDs may be cited; they do not promote a gate to PROVEN by themselves.

path.description: Intended path under test, e.g. CloudFront /auth/login -> ticketed WSS -> guest.
